json.take: You cannot rush the ball forward until your own structure is set, yet Wendel Sandoval carries into a congested zone and disconnects the passing network rather than recycling possession to establish control. The pass is the right idea not for a frantic break, but because moving the ball cleanly secures territory and preserves our shape.
